title: Kissed Smoky Spanish Chicken Paella
description: A nutty and aerated Spanish dish featuring smoky paprika, perfect for a sick day, made with low glycemic ingredients and cooked in an iron teppan.
instructions: Preheat the iron teppan to medium high heat.
In a large bowl, whisk together smoky paprika, olive oil, salt, and black pepper.
Add the chicken breast pieces to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Add the chopped onion to the iron teppan and cook until translucent.
Add the minced garlic to the iron teppan and cook for 1 minute.
Add the chicken breast pieces to the iron teppan and cook until browned on all sides.
Add the cauliflower rice to the iron teppan and cook until lightly browned.
Add the chicken broth to the iron teppan and bring to a simmer.
Reduce the heat to low and cook, covered, for 20 minutes.
Stir in the lemon juice and serve hot.
Cook poultry to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F before serving.
